tdomnk.long_description: Number of times subjects was able to tap the spacebar in 30 seconds with their dominant hand

tdomsdk.short_description: Standard Deviation of the Interval Between Taps
tdomsdk.long_description: The standard deviation of the time interval between taps on the space-bar for the dominant hand

chlrrtav.long_description: Average time taken to press the left or right arrow to correspond with which circle (left or right) is highlighted in each trial (regardless of accuracy)

ctmrec1.long_description: Number of words from a visually presented list correctly recognized against a distracter word- first attempt

ctmrec2.long_description: Number of words from a visually presented list correctly recognized against a distracter word- second attempt

ctmrec3.long_description: Number of words from a visually presented list correctly recognized against a distracter word- third attempt

ctmsco13.long_description: Total score summing scores from trials 1-3

getcpA.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcpD.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcpF.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcpH.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcpN.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcpS.note: missing if no response to all faces

getcrtA.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Anger` faces
getcrtA.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

getcrtD.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Disgust` faces
getcrtD.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

getcrtF.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Fear` faces
getcrtF.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

getcrtH.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Happy` faces
getcrtH.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

getcrtN.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Neutral` faces
getcrtN.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

getcrtS.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for correctly identified `Sad` faces
getcrtS.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

gettrtA.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Anger` faces regardless of accuracy

gettrtD.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Disgust` faces regardless of accuracy

gettrtF.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Fear` faces regardless of accuracy

gettrtH.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Happy` faces regardless of accuracy

gettrtN.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Neutral` faces regardless of accuracy

gettrtS.long_description: Average reaction time of the emotion-selection for `Sad` faces regardless of accuracy

digitot.long_description: Total number of correct trials in the forward digit span task where each incremental span length has two trials
digitot.note: missing if no response to all sequences

digitsp.long_description: Maximum length of a sequence of visually presented digits able to be entered on a keypad in correct order- immediately
digitsp.note: missing if no response to all sequences

vi_difrt.construct: Verbal Interference Difference in Reaction Time
vi_difrt.long_description: Difference in reaction time between the first and second trials of the verbal interference task

vcrtne2.long_description: Average reaction time for the stimuli for which the font-color of the color-word was correctly selected (ignoring the name of the word)

vi_sco2.long_description: Number of stimuli for which the font-color of the color-word was correctly selected (ignoring the name of the word) in the time limit of 30 seconds (i.e a higher score reflects greater speed)

vcrtne.long_description: Average reaction time for the stimuli for which the name of the color-word was correctly selected (ignoring the font-color of the word)

vi_sco1.long_description: Number of stimuli for which the name of the color-word was correctly selected (ignoring the font-color of the word) in the time limit of 30 seconds (i.e a higher score reflects greater speed)

esoadur1.long_description: Total amount of time taken to complete the whole sequence of digits

esoaerr1.long_description: Number of times an incorrect digit in the sequence 1-2-3-4-..-etc.- was pressed

scavr0t1.long_description: Average time between correct responses- e.g.- time intervals between pressing 1&2- 2&3- 3&4- etc.

esoadur2.long_description: Total amount of time taken to complete the whole sequence of digits and letters

esoaerr2.long_description: Number of times an incorrect digit|letter in the sequence 1-A-2-B-..-etc.- was pressed

scavr0t2.long_description: Average time between correct responses- e.g.- time intervals between pressing 1&A- A&2- 2&B- etc.  [NB: Early versions of this test had a 1-minute timeout- subjects timing out in this version are missing this score- this variable only has scores when subjects took less than a minute on the early version- or less than two minutes on the new version (longer timeout threshold) ]

g2avrtk.long_description: Reaction time to spacebar press averaged across all correctly performed green `press` stimuli; stimuli are at regular intervals so there is anticipation and a speed|accuracy trade-off

g2errk.long_description: Total errors (sum of false positive and false negative responses)
g2errk.note: g2fpk + g2fnk = g2errk; missing if no response to any stimuli

g2fnk.long_description: Number of times when the spacebar was not pressed in response to a green `press` stimulus- measures innattention or slow responding
g2fnk.note: g2fpk + g2fnk = g2errk; missing if no response to any stimuli

g2fpk.long_description: Number of times when the spacebar was pressed at any time in response to a red `don`t press` stimulus- measures the failure to inhibit an anticipated response- and high scores indicated speed favored over accuracy
g2fpk.note: g2fpk + g2fnk = g2errk; missing if no response to any stimuli

g2sdrtk.long_description: Standard deviation of reaction time to spacebar press across correctly performed green `press` stimuli

ctmrec4.long_description: Number of words from a visually presented list correctly recognized against a distracter word- fourth attempt after a half-hour delay

dgtcnA.short_description: Anger Correct RT minus Neutral RT
dgtcnA.long_description: Reaction time difference between correctly selected 'Anger' faces and 'Neutral' faces
dgtcnA.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcnD.short_description: Disgust Correct RT minus Neutral RT
dgtcnD.long_description: Reaction time difference between correctly selected 'Disgust' faces and 'Neutral' faces
dgtcnD.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcnF.short_description: Fear Correct RT minus Neutral RT
dgtcnF.long_description: Reaction time difference between correctly selected 'Fear' faces and 'Neutral' faces
dgtcnF.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcnH.short_description: Happy Correct RT minus Neutral RT
dgtcnH.long_description: Reaction time difference between correctly selected 'Happy' faces and 'Neutral' faces
dgtcnH.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcnS.short_description: Sad Correct RT minus Neutral RT
dgtcnS.long_description: Reaction time difference between correctly selected 'Sad' faces and 'Neutral' faces
dgtcnS.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtA.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Anger
dgtcrtA.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Anger faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtA.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtD.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Disgust
dgtcrtD.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Disgust faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtD.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtF.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Fear
dgtcrtF.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Fear faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtF.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtH.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Happy
dgtcrtH.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Happy faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtH.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtN.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Neutral
dgtcrtN.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Neutral faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtN.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

dgtcrtS.short_description: Reaction time for Face Recognition, Sad
dgtcrtS.long_description: Average reaction time of the correctly recognized "Old" Sad faces that were shown previously across all trials
dgtcrtS.note: missing if timeout for all or none correct

wmacck.long_description: Total number of errors (false positives + false negatives)
wmacck.note: wmfnk + wmfpk = wmacck; missing if no response to any stimuli

wmfnk.long_description: Number of times when the space-bar was NOT pressed following a target stimulus
wmfnk.note: wmfnk + wmfpk = wmacck; missing if no response to any stimuli

wmfpk.long_description: Number of times when the space-bar was pressed at any time not in response to a `target` stimulus
wmfpk.note: wmfnk + wmfpk = wmacck; missing if no response to any stimuli

wmrtk.long_description: Reaction time to space-bar press averaged across all correctly identified target stimuli (same letter presented twice in a row)

emzcompk.long_description: Time taken to successfully complete the maze without error twice consecutively

emzerrk.long_description: Cumulative number of all types of errors made across all trials taken to complete the maze without error twice consecutively

emzinitk.long_description: Path learning time` or time taken to the end of the final trial with at least one error- just before successfully completing the maze without error twice consecutively

emzoverk.long_description: Cumulative number of `overrun` errors made across all trials taken to complete the maze without error twice consecutively. Overrun errors are specifically when subjects continue pressing in the same direction of movement through the maze instead of turning where required.

emztrlsk.long_description: Number of trials taken to successfully complete the maze without error twice consecutively
